name: Text Rebuild
description: Paste a short text and get a set of rebuild-the-text exercises (reorder the pieces, fill the gaps, split the words, restore it from initials) that students open from a link, with no accounts.
problem: Language teachers turn each lesson text into reordering, gap-fill, and reconstruction exercises; the tools that make the whole set from one pasted text need a paid subscription, and the free ones each make a single exercise type.
